articles.headline: Louisville's Kelsey tells 5th-year critics 'bring it' as Trimble shines in upset
articles.description: After Seth Trimble led Louisville to a 72-64 win over No. 5 Texas Tech, Cardinals coach Pat Kelsey told critics of teams using fifth-year players, "Everybody can have their opinion. Bring it."

article.headline: Tyler Boston, Will Heimbrodt lead Seattle U past Loyola Chicago 76-63 in Acrisure Series title game
article.description: — Tyler Boston had 21 points and Will Heimbrodt scored 19 to lead Seattle University to a 76-63 victory over Loyola Chicago on Monday in the championship game of the Acrisure Series.
article.linkText: Tyler Boston, Will Heimbrodt lead Seattle U past Loyola Chicago 76-63 in Acrisure Series title game

categories.description: Loyola Chicago Ramblers @ Seattle U Redhawks

event.description: Loyola Chicago Ramblers @ Seattle U Redhawks

keywords: Loyola Chicago Ramblers @ Seattle U Redhawks
article.story: PALM DESERT, Calif. -- — Tyler Boston had 21 points and Will Heimbrodt scored 19 to lead Seattle University to a 76-63 victory over Loyola Chicago on Monday in the championship game of the Acrisure Series. Boston shot 7 for 12 (2 for 3 from 3-point range) and 5 of 6 from the free-throw line for the Redhawks (5-2). Heimbrodt shot 7 of 12 from the floor and added five rebounds, three steals, and four blocks. Halvine Dzellat shot 6 of 8 from the field and 3 for 4 from the line to finish with 15 points, while adding seven rebounds. Jayden Dawson led the way for the Ramblers (4-3) with 12 points and two steals. Ryan Agarwal added 11 points and Guillaume Grotzinger finished with nine points and five assists. Seattle U took the lead for good with 19:38 remaining in the first half. The score was 45-31 at halftime, with Boston racking up 12 points. Up next: Seattle U plays Saturday against UC Irvine at home, and Loyola Chicago visits UMass on Sunday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
